# What this notebook does

Kate, 2026-10-30. The same heatmaps as `44_gc3_cds_grids_by_utr5.Rmd` (GC3 x CDS length, split by
5'UTR length) and `37_utr_cds_length_models.Rmd` (GC3 x CDS length, GC3 x 5'UTR length), but the
outcome is the **hypoxia response of control cells** instead of the eIF3d knockdown effect:

- **Outcome:** log2 TE change, 1hr hypoxia vs normoxia, in siCTRL cells. Positive = TE goes
  **up** in hypoxia. No knockdown is involved, so there are no eIF3d targets and no
  "favorable" direction. Each cell shows the mean TE change of the genes in it.
- **MDA-MB-231:** `output/translation_categories_1hr.csv` (`rna_ribo_te_analysis.Rmd`,
  `deFunction(mode = "TE", control = normoxia, test = hypoxia)`, spike-in normalized).
- **MCF7-SIX1:** `counts/all_norm_to_hyp_changes.csv`, column `LFC_te_sictrl`, in the
  2024_eIF3e_hypoxia repo (`5_hypoxicresponse.Rmd`, interaction coefficient with normoxia and
  RNA as the reference levels, `lfcShrink`-shrunk, not spike-in normalized). The two cell lines'
  values are on different scales, so compare patterns, not numbers.
- **Features come from each cell line's own dominant transcript:** `feature_matrix_tco.rds` for
  MDA-MB-231 and `feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds` for MCF7-SIX1.
- **Genes:** every gene in that matrix with all three features (GC3, CDS length, 5'UTR length) and
  a TE change. Bins are set once on those genes, so a cell means the same range in every panel.
- **Color:** each cell's mean can be either sign, so the scale is diverging and centred on 0:
  Okabe-Ito dark blue `#0072B2` (TE down in hypoxia) to white to vermillion `#D55E00` (TE up in
  hypoxia). The limits are symmetric and shared by every panel of a figure.

This run: **`r params$dataset`**.

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(here) })
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
SAVE <- isTRUE(params$save_plots)
TOL <- 1e-12
NB <- as.integer(params$n_bins); NU <- as.integer(params$n_utr5)
stopifnot("n_bins must be >= 2" = NB >= 2, "n_utr5 must be >= 2" = NU >= 2,
          "unknown dataset" = params$dataset %in% c("mda231", "mcf7six1"))
eif3_repo <- "/Users/katematlin/github/2024_eIF3e_hypoxia/2024_eIF3e_hypoxia"
cfg <- list(
  mda231 = list(label = "MDA-MB-231 siCTRL 1hr hypoxia vs normoxia", tag = "mda231_sictrl_hyp_vs_nor_1hr",
                matrix_rds = "feature_matrix_tco.rds"),
  mcf7six1 = list(label = "MCF7-SIX1 siCTRL 1hr hypoxia vs normoxia", tag = "mcf7six1_sictrl_hyp_vs_nor_1hr",
                  matrix_rds = "feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds"))[[params$dataset]]
```

# 1. Data and direction checks

Both files are read in every run, because the direction check below compares the two cell lines.

```{r data}
te_231 <- read_csv(here("output", "translation_categories_1hr.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(gene_id_clean = sub("[.].*", "", gene_id), te_lfc, te_padj, rna_lfc)
te_mcf <- read_csv(file.path(eif3_repo, "counts", "all_norm_to_hyp_changes.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(gene_id_clean = sub("[.].*", "", gene_id), te_lfc = LFC_te_sictrl, te_padj = padj_te_sictrl, rna_lfc = LFC_rna_sictrl)
stopifnot("duplicate genes in the MDA-MB-231 TE file" = !anyDuplicated(te_231$gene_id_clean),
          "duplicate genes in the MCF7-SIX1 TE file" = !anyDuplicated(te_mcf$gene_id_clean),
          "log fold changes not finite" = all(is.finite(c(te_231$te_lfc, te_mcf$te_lfc)[!is.na(c(te_231$te_lfc, te_mcf$te_lfc))])))
cat(sprintf("MDA-MB-231: %s genes, median TE change %+.3f | MCF7-SIX1: %s genes, median %+.3f\n",
            scales::comma(nrow(te_231)), median(te_231$te_lfc, na.rm = TRUE),
            scales::comma(nrow(te_mcf)), median(te_mcf$te_lfc, na.rm = TRUE)))
```

## Direction: positive must mean higher in hypoxia

Three rulers, all asserted:

1. **The producing code**, parsed from source rather than retyped. MDA-MB-231's TE call has
   `control_condition = "normoxia"` and `test_condition = "hypoxia"`. MCF7-SIX1 relevels
   `condition` to `ref = "normoxia"` and `library` to `ref = "rna"`, and takes coefficient [4]
   of `~condition + library + condition:library` (the hypoxia x ribo interaction, i.e.
   log2 TE hypoxia / normoxia), which is the result saved as `LFC_te_sictrl`.
2. **Canonical HIF-1 targets gain mRNA within 1hr in MDA-MB-231** (ADM, ANKRD37, PDK1, NDRG1;
   RNA leg of the same DESeq2 run). I looked at these values while writing this check, so it
   confirms orientation rather than testing a prediction. MCF7-SIX1 has no comparable early
   RNA induction of these genes (all within +/-0.03), so this ruler is applied to MDA-MB-231 only.
3. **The two cell lines agree:** Spearman of TE change across shared genes must be positive.
   A flip in only one file would make it negative.

```{r direction}
src_231 <- readLines(here("code", "rna_ribo_te_analysis.Rmd"))
te_chunk <- src_231[seq(grep("^```\\{r te_analysis_1hr\\}", src_231), length.out = 12)]
stopifnot("MDA-MB-231 TE call is not normoxia -> hypoxia" =
            any(grepl('control_condition = "normoxia"', te_chunk)) && any(grepl('test_condition = "hypoxia"', te_chunk)) &&
            any(grepl('mode = "TE"', te_chunk)),
          "translation_categories_1hr.csv is not written from the 1hr results" =
            any(grepl('write_csv\\(categorized_with_padj_1hr, here\\("output", "translation_categories_1hr.csv"\\)\\)', src_231)))
src_mcf <- readLines(file.path(eif3_repo, "code", "5_hypoxicresponse.Rmd"))
stopifnot("MCF7-SIX1 condition reference is not normoxia" =
            any(grepl('metadata_acute_sictrl\\$condition <- relevel\\(factor\\(metadata_acute_sictrl\\$condition\\), ref = "normoxia"\\)', src_mcf)),
          "MCF7-SIX1 library reference is not rna" =
            any(grepl('metadata_acute_sictrl\\$library <- relevel\\(factor\\(metadata_acute_sictrl\\$library\\), ref = "rna"\\)', src_mcf)),
          "MCF7-SIX1 coefficient is not the interaction" =
            any(grepl("results\\(ddsMat_acute_sictrl, name=resultsNames\\(ddsMat_acute_sictrl\\)\\[4\\]", src_mcf)),
          "LFC_te_sictrl is not taken from res_acute_sictrl" =
            any(grepl("sictrl_te <- res_acute_sictrl", src_mcf)) && any(grepl('colnames\\(sictrl_te\\)\\[3\\] ="LFC_te_sictrl"', src_mcf)))

anno <- read_tsv(here("accessories", "human", "gene_anno_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv"), col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)
hif <- c("ADM", "ANKRD37", "PDK1", "NDRG1")
hif_rna <- te_231$rna_lfc[match(sub("[.].*", "", anno$X1[match(hif, anno$X2)]), te_231$gene_id_clean)]
print(setNames(round(hif_rna, 2), hif))
stopifnot("a HIF-1 target is missing" = !anyNA(hif_rna),
          "HIF-1 targets do not gain mRNA in hypoxia: MDA-MB-231 direction flipped" = all(hif_rna > 0.3))

j <- inner_join(te_231, te_mcf, by = "gene_id_clean", suffix = c("_231", "_mcf")) %>% filter(!is.na(te_lfc_231), !is.na(te_lfc_mcf))
rho_x <- cor(j$te_lfc_231, j$te_lfc_mcf, method = "spearman")
cat(sprintf("Spearman TE change MDA-MB-231 vs MCF7-SIX1 = %+.3f, n = %s shared genes\n", rho_x, scales::comma(nrow(j))))
stopifnot("cell lines disagree in direction" = rho_x > 0.2)
```

## Genes and features

```{r genes}
te <- if (params$dataset == "mda231") te_231 else te_mcf
fm <- readRDS(file.path(O, cfg$matrix_rds))
stopifnot("matrix has duplicate genes" = !anyDuplicated(fm$gene_id_clean),
          "feature columns missing" = all(c("gc3_internal", "log2_cds_length", "log2_utr5_length", "cds_length", "utr5_length") %in% names(fm)),
          "outcome must not be a matrix column" = !"LFC_te_sictrl" %in% names(fm))
num <- function(col) as.numeric(unlist(fm[[col]]))
d <- tibble(gene_id_clean = fm$gene_id_clean, symbol = fm$symbol,
            gc3 = num("gc3_internal"), cds = num("log2_cds_length"), utr5 = num("log2_utr5_length"),
            cds_nt = num("cds_length"), utr5_nt = num("utr5_length")) %>%
  mutate(te_lfc = te$te_lfc[match(gene_id_clean, te$gene_id_clean)])
n_mat <- nrow(d)
d <- d %>% filter(!is.na(gc3), !is.na(cds), !is.na(utr5), !is.na(te_lfc))
stopifnot("log2 lengths are not log2(nt + 1)" =
            max(abs(d$cds - log2(d$cds_nt + 1)), abs(d$utr5 - log2(d$utr5_nt + 1))) < TOL,
          "GC3 outside [0, 100]" = all(d$gc3 >= 0 & d$gc3 <= 100),
          "GC3 median outside 40-65%" = between(median(d$gc3), 40, 65),
          "ACTB missing" = "ACTB" %in% d$symbol,
          "ACTB GC3 not above median (ACTB is GC3-rich)" = d$gc3[d$symbol == "ACTB"] > median(d$gc3))
cat(sprintf("%s: %s of %s matrix genes have all three features and a TE change; mean TE change %+.3f\n",
            cfg$label, scales::comma(nrow(d)), scales::comma(n_mat), mean(d$te_lfc)))
rho <- c(utr5 = cor(d$utr5, d$te_lfc, method = "spearman"), cds = cor(d$cds, d$te_lfc, method = "spearman"),
         gc3 = cor(d$gc3, d$te_lfc, method = "spearman"))
knitr::kable(t(round(rho, 3)), caption = sprintf("Spearman of each feature with TE change (hypoxia vs normoxia), n = %s", scales::comma(nrow(d))))
```

## Bins

```{r bins}
# Equal-count bins on all genes, labelled in natural units (as in 37_ / 44_)
q_lab <- function(x, n) {
  br <- unique(quantile(x, seq(0, 1, length.out = n + 1)))
  cut(x, br, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = sprintf("%s-%s", scales::comma(round(2^head(br, -1) - 1)), scales::comma(round(2^br[-1] - 1))))
}
q_lab_pct <- function(x, n) {
  br <- unique(quantile(x, seq(0, 1, length.out = n + 1)))
  cut(x, br, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = sprintf("%.1f-%.1f", head(br, -1), br[-1]))
}
d <- d %>% mutate(bx = q_lab(cds, NB), by = q_lab_pct(gc3, NB), bxu = q_lab(utr5, NB), bu = q_lab(utr5, NU),
                  bf = factor(if_else(utr5_nt <= params$utr5_floor_nt,
                                      sprintf("<= %d nt", params$utr5_floor_nt), sprintf("> %d nt", params$utr5_floor_nt)),
                              levels = sprintf(c("<= %d nt", "> %d nt"), params$utr5_floor_nt)))
stopifnot("CDS bins collapsed" = nlevels(d$bx) == NB, "GC3 bins collapsed" = nlevels(d$by) == NB,
          "5'UTR bins collapsed" = nlevels(d$bxu) == NB, "5'UTR groups collapsed" = nlevels(d$bu) == NU,
          "a gene is unbinned" = !anyNA(d[, c("bx", "by", "bxu", "bu", "bf")]),
          "bins out of order" = all(diff(tapply(d$cds, d$bx, median)) > 0) && all(diff(tapply(d$gc3, d$by, median)) > 0) &&
            all(diff(tapply(d$utr5, d$bxu, median)) > 0) && all(diff(tapply(d$utr5, d$bu, median)) > 0))
# Equal count up to ties: every bin within 10% of n / bins
eq <- function(f, k) all(abs(table(f) - nrow(d) / k) / (nrow(d) / k) < 0.10)
stopifnot("CDS bins not equal-count" = eq(d$bx, NB), "GC3 bins not equal-count" = eq(d$by, NB),
          "5'UTR bins not equal-count" = eq(d$bxu, NB))
print(table(`5'UTR group` = d$bu)); print(table(`5'UTR floor split` = d$bf))
```

# 2. The grids

```{r grid_fun}
# One grid: x bins, y bins (GC3 unless given), optional panel factor ("all" = unsplit)
grid_cells <- function(xcol, panel = NULL, ycol = "by") {
  dd <- d %>% mutate(bxx = .data[[xcol]], by = .data[[ycol]])
  dd$panel <- if (is.null(panel)) factor(rep("all", nrow(d))) else dd[[panel]]
  gc <- dd %>% group_by(panel, bx = bxx, by) %>% summarise(n = n(), lfc = mean(te_lfc), .groups = "drop")
  # Independent recomputation of every cell with base R, and a pooling check against the unsplit grid
  key <- paste(dd$panel, dd$bxx, dd$by); m <- tapply(dd$te_lfc, key, mean)
  stopifnot("cell means differ from base-R recomputation" = max(abs(gc$lfc - m[paste(gc$panel, gc$bx, gc$by)])) < TOL,
            "cells do not add up to the genes" = sum(gc$n) == nrow(d),
            "every panel must have every cell" = nrow(gc) == nlevels(dd$panel) * NB^2)
  pooled <- gc %>% group_by(bx, by) %>% summarise(lfc = sum(lfc * n) / sum(n), .groups = "drop")
  flat <- dd %>% group_by(bx = bxx, by) %>% summarise(lfc = mean(te_lfc), .groups = "drop")
  stopifnot("panels do not pool back to the unsplit grid" = max(abs(pooled$lfc - flat$lfc)) < 1e-10)
  gc
}

plot_grid <- function(gc, xlab, what, file_tag, panel_title = "", ylab = "GC3 (%)") {
  lim <- c(-1, 1) * max(abs(gc$lfc))
  pn <- gc %>% group_by(panel) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
  gc <- gc %>% mutate(panel = factor(sprintf("%s %s (n = %s)", panel_title, panel, scales::comma(pn$n[match(panel, pn$panel)])),
                                     levels = sprintf("%s %s (n = %s)", panel_title, pn$panel, scales::comma(pn$n))))
  np <- nlevels(gc$panel)
  p <- ggplot(gc, aes(bx, by, fill = lfc)) + geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.2f\nn = %d", lfc, n)), size = if (NB > 5) 2.1 else 2.6) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#0072B2", mid = "white", high = "#D55E00", midpoint = 0, limits = lim,
                         name = "mean log2 TE\nhypoxia vs\nnormoxia") +
    labs(x = sprintf("%s, %d equal-count bins", xlab, NB), y = sprintf("%s, %d equal-count bins", ylab, NB),
         title = sprintf("%s: mean TE change by %s", cfg$label, what),
         subtitle = sprintf("mean log2(TE hypoxia / TE normoxia) of every gene in the cell, siCTRL; bins set on all %s genes%s; overall mean %+.3f",
                            scales::comma(nrow(d)), if (np > 1) "; one color scale for all panels" else "", mean(d$te_lfc))) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8),
          strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
  if (np > 1) p <- p + facet_wrap(~ panel, nrow = 1)
  print(p)
  w <- if (np > 1) 5.2 * NB / 5 * np + 1.5 else 11 * max(0.65, NB / 10)
  h <- if (np > 1) 6 * max(1, NB / 7) else 9 * max(0.65, NB / 10)
  if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", sprintf("45_mean_lfc_grid_%s_%dbins_%s.pdf", file_tag, NB, cfg$tag)), p, width = w, height = h)
}
```

## The corners in numbers

Mean TE change in the short-CDS / low-GC3 corner and the long-CDS / high-GC3 corner of each 5'UTR
panel. No direction is asserted, because nothing here predicts one.

```{r corners}
corner <- gu %>% filter((bx == levels(d$bx)[1] & by == levels(d$by)[1]) | (bx == levels(d$bx)[NB] & by == levels(d$by)[NB])) %>%
  mutate(corner = if_else(bx == levels(d$bx)[1], "short_cds_low_gc3", "long_cds_high_gc3")) %>%
  dplyr::select(panel, corner, n, lfc) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = corner, values_from = c(n, lfc)) %>%
  mutate(gap = lfc_short_cds_low_gc3 - lfc_long_cds_high_gc3)
stopifnot("corner table incomplete" = nrow(corner) == NU && !anyNA(corner))
knitr::kable(corner, digits = 3, caption = "corner cells per 5'UTR group: mean TE change, hypoxia vs normoxia")
```

# 3. TE change against each feature

The scatters of `37_utr_cds_length_models.Rmd`, redrawn for this outcome: every gene in the grids,
one point each, with a linear fit (95% CI). The y axis is zoomed to the central 99.8% of genes so a
few extreme genes do not flatten the cloud; the fit and rho still use every gene.

```{r te_scatters, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6, results = "asis"}
xs <- list(gc3  = list(lab = "GC3 (%)", file = "gc3"),
           utr5 = list(lab = "log2 5'UTR length", file = "utr5_length"),
           cds  = list(lab = "log2 CDS length", file = "cds_length"))
ylim <- quantile(d$te_lfc, c(0.001, 0.999))
n_off <- sum(d$te_lfc < ylim[1] | d$te_lfc > ylim[2])
for (v in names(xs)) {
  r <- cor(d[[v]], d$te_lfc, method = "spearman")
  stopifnot("rho differs from the Spearman table above" = abs(r - rho[[v]]) < TOL)
  fit <- summary(lm(d$te_lfc ~ d[[v]]))
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\nslope %.4f, adjusted R2 %.3f; y zoomed, %d genes off-scale (still in the fit)\n\n",
              xs[[v]]$lab, coef(fit)[2, 1], fit$adj.r.squared, n_off))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(.data[[v]], te_lfc)) +
    geom_point(color = "grey70", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, se = TRUE) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.6,
             label = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.3f\nn = %s genes", r, scales::comma(nrow(d)))) +
    labs(x = xs[[v]]$lab, y = "log2 TE change (hypoxia / normoxia)",
         title = cfg$label, subtitle = "siCTRL; all genes in the grids; line = linear fit (95% CI)") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
  print(p)
  if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", sprintf("45_te_change_vs_%s_%s.pdf", xs[[v]]$file, cfg$tag)), p, width = 7, height = 6)
}
```

# 4. Hypoxia response vs eIF3d dependence, colored by CDS length (MDA-MB-231 only)

Kate, 2026-10-30. One point per gene:

- **x:** TE change in hypoxia, control cells (log2 TE hypoxia / normoxia, siCTRL, 1hr), as above.
- **y:** TE change on eIF3d knockdown in hypoxia 1hr, log2(sictrl / si3d) from
  `translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv` (the filename states the ratio
  backwards; positive = eIF3d promotes).
- **color:** CDS length z-score, the same z as the reporter z-score plots
  (`gene_feature_zscores_gc3_length_hypoxia_1hr.csv`), **raw sign**: positive = longer CDS than
  average. Not negated here. The color is capped at +/-2.5 so a few very long CDSs do not wash out
  the rest; the points are drawn with the most extreme z on top.
- EIF3D is dropped: its TE change on knockdown is an artefact of depleting it.

```{r scatter_3d_vs_hyp, eval = params$dataset == "mda231", fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 6.5}
de3 <- read_csv(here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("[.].*", "", gene_id))
kd <- de3$rna_lfc[de3$symbol %in% "EIF3D"]
stopifnot("duplicate genes in the si3d file" = !anyDuplicated(de3$gene_id_clean),
          "EIF3D rna_lfc not > 1: wrong file or flipped direction" = length(kd) == 1 && kd > 1)
cat(sprintf("si3d file: EIF3D rna_lfc %+.2f -> log2(sictrl / si3d), positive = eIF3d promotes\n", kd))

zc <- read_csv(file.path(O, "gene_feature_zscores_gc3_length_hypoxia_1hr.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot("z table genes differ from this notebook's genes" = setequal(zc$gene_id_clean, d$gene_id_clean),
          "z table CDS length differs from the matrix" =
            max(abs(zc$cds - d$cds[match(zc$gene_id_clean, d$gene_id_clean)])) < TOL,
          "z_cds is not (x - mean) / sd over the z table's genes" =
            max(abs(zc$z_cds - (zc$cds - mean(zc$cds)) / sd(zc$cds))) < 1e-10)

sc <- d %>% transmute(gene_id_clean, symbol, hyp_te = te_lfc,
                      kd_te = de3$te_lfc[match(gene_id_clean, de3$gene_id_clean)],
                      z_cds = zc$z_cds[match(gene_id_clean, zc$gene_id_clean)]) %>%
  filter(symbol != "EIF3D", !is.na(kd_te))
stopifnot("z missing for a gene" = !anyNA(sc$z_cds), "log fold changes not finite" = all(is.finite(sc$kd_te)),
          "longest-CDS gene does not have the highest z" = sc$z_cds[which.max(d$cds[match(sc$gene_id_clean, d$gene_id_clean)])] == max(sc$z_cds))
rho_xy <- cor(sc$hyp_te, sc$kd_te, method = "spearman")
cat(sprintf("genes plotted %s; Spearman(hypoxia TE change, eIF3d TE change) = %+.3f; Spearman(z_cds, eIF3d TE change) = %+.3f; Spearman(z_cds, hypoxia TE change) = %+.3f\n",
            scales::comma(nrow(sc)), rho_xy, cor(sc$z_cds, sc$kd_te, method = "spearman"), cor(sc$z_cds, sc$hyp_te, method = "spearman")))

ZCAP <- 2.5
lx <- quantile(sc$hyp_te, c(0.001, 0.999)); ly <- quantile(sc$kd_te, c(0.001, 0.999))
n_off <- sum(sc$hyp_te < lx[1] | sc$hyp_te > lx[2] | sc$kd_te < ly[1] | sc$kd_te > ly[2])
p_sc <- ggplot(sc %>% arrange(abs(z_cds)), aes(hyp_te, kd_te, color = pmax(pmin(z_cds, ZCAP), -ZCAP))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "#0072B2", mid = "grey85", high = "#D55E00", midpoint = 0, limits = c(-ZCAP, ZCAP),
                         name = "CDS length\nz-score\n(+ = longer)") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.6,
           label = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.3f\nn = %s genes", rho_xy, scales::comma(nrow(sc)))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = lx, ylim = ly) +
  labs(x = "log2 TE change, hypoxia vs normoxia (siCTRL, 1hr)", y = "log2 TE change, sictrl vs si3d (hypoxia 1hr)",
       title = "MDA-MB-231: hypoxia response vs eIF3d dependence",
       subtitle = sprintf("n = %s genes; CDS length z raw sign, capped at +/-%.1f", scales::comma(nrow(sc)), ZCAP)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7))
p_sc
if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", "45_te_hypoxia_sictrl_vs_te_si3d_hypoxia_colored_by_cds_z_mda231_1hr.pdf"), p_sc, width = 7.5, height = 6.5)
```

## eIF3d TE change minus hypoxia TE change, against CDS length

Kate, 2026-10-30. Same genes, no color:

- **x:** CDS length z-score (raw sign, + = longer), not capped.
- **y:** the y axis above minus the x axis above, per gene: log2 TE change sictrl vs si3d
  (hypoxia 1hr) - log2 TE change hypoxia vs normoxia (siCTRL 1hr). Positive = the gene depends on
  eIF3d more than its TE moves with hypoxia in control cells. The two are different contrasts on the same
  log2 scale, so the difference is a plain subtraction of LFCs.

```{r diff_vs_cds_z, eval = params$dataset == "mda231", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6}
sc <- sc %>% mutate(diff_te = kd_te - hyp_te)
stopifnot("difference not finite" = all(is.finite(sc$diff_te)),
          "difference is not y - x of the scatter above" =
            max(abs(sc$diff_te - (de3$te_lfc[match(sc$gene_id_clean, de3$gene_id_clean)] -
                                    te_231$te_lfc[match(sc$gene_id_clean, te_231$gene_id_clean)]))) < TOL)
rho_d <- cor(sc$z_cds, sc$diff_te, method = "spearman")
fit_d <- summary(lm(diff_te ~ z_cds, data = sc))
ld <- quantile(sc$diff_te, c(0.001, 0.999)); nd_off <- sum(sc$diff_te < ld[1] | sc$diff_te > ld[2])
cat(sprintf("Spearman(z_cds, difference) = %+.3f; slope %.4f per SD; adjusted R2 %.3f; n = %s; y zoomed, %d genes off-scale (still in the fit)\n",
            rho_d, coef(fit_d)[2, 1], fit_d$adj.r.squared, scales::comma(nrow(sc)), nd_off))
p_d <- ggplot(sc, aes(z_cds, diff_te)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey70", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, se = TRUE) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.6,
           label = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.3f\nn = %s genes", rho_d, scales::comma(nrow(sc)))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = ld) +
  labs(x = "CDS length z-score (+ = longer)",
       y = "log2 TE change sictrl vs si3d (hypoxia)\nminus log2 TE change hypoxia vs normoxia (siCTRL)",
       title = "MDA-MB-231: eIF3d TE change minus hypoxia TE change, by CDS length",
       subtitle = sprintf("n = %s genes; CDS length z raw sign; line = linear fit (95%% CI)", scales::comma(nrow(sc)))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
p_d
if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", "45_te_si3d_minus_te_hypoxia_sictrl_vs_cds_z_mda231_1hr.pdf"), p_d, width = 7, height = 6)
```

## Is eIF3d's short-CDS preference just the hypoxia response?

Kate, 2026-10-30. The difference plot above cannot answer this: both TE changes fall with CDS
length by similar amounts, so subtracting cancels the slopes, and its height is set by the two
contrasts' different centres, not by biology. The direct test is a regression:

- **unadjusted:** eIF3d TE change ~ CDS length z
- **adjusted:** eIF3d TE change ~ CDS length z + hypoxia TE change (siCTRL)

If the short-CDS effect on eIF3d dependence were the hypoxia response, the CDS slope would shrink
toward 0 once hypoxia TE change is in the model.

```{r cds_adjusted, eval = params$dataset == "mda231", fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 3.8}
m0 <- lm(kd_te ~ z_cds, data = sc); m1 <- lm(kd_te ~ z_cds + hyp_te, data = sc)
co <- bind_rows(
  as_tibble(summary(m0)$coefficients, rownames = "term") %>% mutate(model = "unadjusted", adj_r2 = summary(m0)$adj.r.squared),
  as_tibble(summary(m1)$coefficients, rownames = "term") %>% mutate(model = "adjusted for hypoxia TE change", adj_r2 = summary(m1)$adj.r.squared)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(estimate = Estimate, se = `Std. Error`, t = `t value`, p = `Pr(>|t|)`) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)")
# The unadjusted slope is the ordinary least-squares slope, recomputed longhand
stopifnot("unadjusted slope differs from cov / var" =
            abs(coef(m0)[["z_cds"]] - cov(sc$z_cds, sc$kd_te) / var(sc$z_cds)) < 1e-10,
          "model n differs from the plotted genes" = nobs(m0) == nrow(sc) && nobs(m1) == nrow(sc))
knitr::kable(co %>% dplyr::select(model, term, estimate, se, t, p, adj_r2), digits = 4,
             caption = sprintf("eIF3d TE change (sictrl vs si3d, hypoxia 1hr) regressed on CDS length z, n = %s genes; z_cds slope is per SD", scales::comma(nrow(sc))))
cat(sprintf("Pearson(eIF3d TE change, hypoxia TE change) = %+.3f; Pearson(z_cds, hypoxia TE change) = %+.3f\n",
            cor(sc$kd_te, sc$hyp_te), cor(sc$z_cds, sc$hyp_te)))
cat(sprintf("CDS slope retained after adjustment: %.0f%%\n", 100 * coef(m1)[["z_cds"]] / coef(m0)[["z_cds"]]))

cc <- co %>% filter(term == "z_cds") %>% mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("unadjusted", "adjusted for hypoxia TE change")))
p_cc <- ggplot(cc, aes(estimate, model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = estimate - 1.96 * se, xmax = estimate + 1.96 * se), height = 0.15) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, color = "#E69F00") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.4f (t = %.1f)", estimate, t)), vjust = -1.2, size = 3.2) +
  labs(x = "CDS length z slope on eIF3d TE change (log2 per SD, 95% CI)", y = NULL,
       title = "MDA-MB-231: CDS length effect on eIF3d dependence, hypoxia 1hr",
       subtitle = sprintf("n = %s genes", scales::comma(nrow(sc)))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
p_cc
if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", "45_cds_z_slope_on_te_si3d_adjusted_for_hypoxia_te_mda231_1hr.pdf"), p_cc, width = 6.5, height = 3.8)
```
